homePage.mainDesc: Learn how FlowBoard structures organizations, projects, sprint cycles, and real-time kanban boards for high-velocity software engineering squads.
homePage.overviewP1: FlowBoard is an opinionated project orchestration platform built for high-throughput engineering teams. Rather than treating issues as isolated tickets, FlowBoard couples telemetry, real-time board states, and hierarchical permission boundaries into a single operational canvas.
homePage.overviewP2: Designed to bridge tactical issue management with continuous integration feedback loops, FlowBoard guarantees sub-50ms reactive updates across connected browser sessions using dedicated WebSocket multiplexing.
homePage.workspaceIsolationDesc: FlowBoard isolates telemetry and workspace data strictly at the Organization level before drilling into Projects. API keys and service integrations cannot bridge organization barriers without explicit multi-tenant cross-grants.
homePage.archScopesDesc: FlowBoard’s object model is strictly hierarchical. Data ownership flows downward through four core tiers:
homePage.archScopeOrgDesc: Top-level billing entity, enterprise SSO boundaries, global audit logs, and member provisioning.
homePage.archScopeProjectDesc: Domain-specific repositories of engineering initiatives with custom workflow state definitions.
homePage.archScopeKanbanDesc: Real-time projection of issues organized by status columns, active sprint milestones, and swimlanes.
homePage.archScopeIssueDesc: Atomic work unit containing technical telemetry, Git branch connections, subtask graphs, and estimates.
homePage.coreEntityDesc: Every entity in FlowBoard carries deterministic prefix keys (e.g. FLW-1042) that resolve globally within an organization cluster.
homePage.coreEntityLi1Text: Team members are authenticated against an Org, inheriting granular RBAC.
homePage.coreEntityLi2Text: Engineering leads can create synthesis boards aggregating issues.
homePage.coreEntityLi3Text: Time-bounded cycles (1-4 weeks) that enforce commit-freeze checkpoints.
